name: Msty
summary: Sleek polished desktop client uniting local Ollama GGUF models, web RAG search, split multi-model chat, and zero cloud logins.
ranking_rationale: Effortless 1-click local model downloads without touching terminal commands; weighed against desktop source partially closed (free personal tier covers almost everything).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Effortless 1-click local model downloads without touching terminal commands
Chat offline privately with uncensored RP models side by side
Split-pane prompt comparison & custom knowledge stacks
cons: Desktop source partially closed (free personal tier covers almost everything)
Heavier RAM footprint on desktop Electron app
